import numpy as np, time

def ref(A):
    w,v=np.linalg.eig(A); i=np.argmax(np.abs(w)); return w[i], v[:,i]

def power_complex(A, maxit=60, tol=1e-11):
    n=A.shape[0]
    x=np.empty(n,dtype=np.complex128)
    x.real=np.arange(1,n+1)*0.6180339887498949+0.3
    x.imag=np.arange(1,n+1)*0.4142135623730950+0.7
    x/=np.linalg.norm(x)
    anorm=np.linalg.norm(A,1)
    for it in range(maxit):
        y=A@x
        lam=x.conj()@y
        r=y-lam*x
        if np.linalg.norm(r) <= tol*max(1.0,abs(lam)):
            return lam, x
        nx=np.linalg.norm(y)
        x=y/nx
    return lam, x

def power_real(A, maxit=60, tol=1e-11):
    n=A.shape[0]
    x=np.arange(1,n+1,dtype=float)*0.6180339887498949+0.3
    x/=np.linalg.norm(x)
    for it in range(maxit):
        y=A@x
        lam=x@y
        r=y-lam*x
        if np.linalg.norm(r)<=tol*max(1.0,abs(lam)):
            return lam,x
        nx=np.linalg.norm(y)
        x=y/nx
    return lam,x

def block2(A, maxit=30, tol=1e-12):
    n=A.shape[0]
    Q=np.empty((n,2))
    Q[:,0]=np.arange(1,n+1)*0.6180339887498949+0.3
    Q[:,1]=np.arange(1,n+1)*0.4142135623730950+0.7
    Q,_=np.linalg.qr(Q)
    for it in range(maxit):
        Z=A@Q
        Q,R=np.linalg.qr(Z)
        # ritz
        B=Q.T@(A@Q)
        w,V=np.linalg.eig(B)
        i=np.argmax(np.abs(w))
        lam=w[i]; v=Q@V[:,i]
        r=A@v-lam*v
        if np.linalg.norm(r)<=tol*max(1.0,abs(lam)):
            return lam,v
    return lam,v

def arnoldi(A, k=6, tol=1e-11):
    n=A.shape[0]
    k=min(k,n)
    Q=np.empty((n,k+1))
    q=np.arange(1,n+1,dtype=float)*0.6180339887498949+0.3
    q/=np.linalg.norm(q)
    Q[:,0]=q
    H=np.zeros((k+1,k))
    for j in range(k):
        z=A@Q[:,j]
        for i in range(j+1):
            H[i,j]=Q[:,i]@z
            z-=H[i,j]*Q[:,i]
        # reorth
        for i in range(j+1):
            c=Q[:,i]@z
            H[i,j]+=c
            z-=c*Q[:,i]
        H[j+1,j]=np.linalg.norm(z)
        if H[j+1,j] < 1e-14:
            k=j+1
            break
        Q[:,j+1]=z/H[j+1,j]
    w,V=np.linalg.eig(H[:k,:k])
    i=np.argmax(np.abs(w))
    lam=w[i]
    v=Q[:,:k]@V[:,i]
    v/=np.linalg.norm(v)
    r=A@v-lam*v
    if np.linalg.norm(r)<=tol*max(1.0,abs(lam)):
        return lam,v
    return None

def arnoldi_iter(A, k0=4, kmax=None, tol=1e-11):
    n=A.shape[0]
    if kmax is None: kmax=n
    # incremental? just call increasing
    out=None
    for k in range(min(k0,n), kmax+1):
        out=arnoldi(A,k,tol)
        if out is not None: return out
    return power_complex(A)

def bench(fn, sizes=range(2,11,2), N=2000):
    for size in sizes:
        dts=[]; errs=[]
        for i in range(N):
            A=np.random.normal(size=(size,size))
            t0=time.perf_counter(); w,v=fn(A); t1=time.perf_counter()
            dts.append(t1-t0)
            if i<200:
                errs.append(np.linalg.norm(A@v-w*v)/max(1,np.linalg.norm(v)))
        print(fn.__name__, size, f"{np.median(dts)*1e6:.2f}us", "err", max(errs))
    print()

if __name__=='__main__':
    import sys
    names=sys.argv[1:] or ['ref','power_complex','power_real','block2','arnoldi_iter']
    funcs={'ref':ref,'power_complex':power_complex,'power_real':power_real,'block2':block2,'arnoldi_iter':arnoldi_iter}
    for nm in names: bench(funcs[nm])

def arnoldi_H(A,k):
    n=A.shape[0]; k=min(k,n)
    Q=np.zeros((n,k+1)); H=np.zeros((k+1,k))
    q=np.array([np.sin((i+1)*1.234+0.7) for i in range(n)]); q/=np.linalg.norm(q)
    Q[:,0]=q
    for j in range(k):
        z=A@Q[:,j]
        for i in range(j+1):
            H[i,j]=Q[:,i]@z; z-=H[i,j]*Q[:,i]
        for i in range(j+1):
            c=Q[:,i]@z; H[i,j]+=c; z-=c*Q[:,i]
        H[j+1,j]=np.linalg.norm(z)
        if H[j+1,j]<1e-14: k=j+1; break
        Q[:,j+1]=z/H[j+1,j]
    return H[:k,:k],Q[:,:k],k

    n=A.shape[0]; I=np.eye(n)

    for _ in range(iters):
        try: y=np.linalg.solve(M,x)
        except np.linalg.LinAlgError: y=np.linalg.lstsq(M,x,rcond=None)[0]
        ny=np.linalg.norm(y)

import numpy as np

def eig2_shift(a,b,c,d):
    tr=a+d; det=a*d-b*c; disc=tr*tr-4*det
    s=np.sqrt(disc+0j)
    l1=(tr+s)/2; l2=(tr-s)/2
    return l1 if abs(l1-d)<=abs(l2-d) else l2

def dense_qr(A,tol=1e-14,maxit=1000):
    n=A.shape[0]; T=A.astype(complex).copy(); eigs=[]; k=n; it=0; per=0
    while k>0:
        if k==1:
            eigs.append(T[0,0]); break
        # last row norm
        rn=np.linalg.norm(T[k-1,:k-1]); an=np.linalg.norm(T[:k,:k])
        if rn <= tol*max(1,an):
            eigs.append(T[k-1,k-1]); k-=1; per=0; continue

        mu=eig2_shift(T[k-2,k-2],T[k-2,k-1],T[k-1,k-2],T[k-1,k-1])
        B=T[:k,:k]-mu*np.eye(k)
        Q,R=np.linalg.qr(B)
        T[:k,:k]=R@Q+mu*np.eye(k)
